t.O WhatsApp é o canal onde o cliente bras: WhatsApp is the channel where Brazilian customers already are, already reply and already trust. Using it to ask for reviews works — as long as the message arrives at the right time, with the right link and without sounding like a demand. Here's how to create your review link, when to send it, 8 messages you can copy and adapt by type of business, and where this channel falls short (because it does).
t.Uma dona de salão em Belo Horizonte fazi: A salon owner in Belo Horizonte was doing everything right: she messaged every client asking for a review. Except she sent them on Sunday night, all at once, with the text "Hi! Please review us on Google, it's really important 🙏" and a screenshot of Google telling the person to search for the salon. The response rate was close to zero.
t.Ela mudou três coisas — o momento, o lin: She changed three things — the timing, the link and the first sentence — and started getting reviews with some regularity. It didn't become a machine: WhatsApp never does. But it got off zero. That adjustment is what this guide describes.

t.Como pedir o número sem virar spam: How to ask for the number without becoming spam
t.Você só pode mandar mensagem pra quem te: You can only message people who have a relationship with you — customers who bought, booked or hired you. Buying contact lists or using numbers that came from elsewhere isn't just ineffective: it's a problem under the LGPD (Brazil's data protection law).
t.Na prática, o número normalmente já está: In practice, you usually already have the number (booking, sign-up, delivery order, warranty). If you don't, the natural moment to ask is at checkout: "I'll send you the receipt on WhatsApp, what's the best number?". And when someone asks to stop receiving messages, remove them from the list right away.

t.Pedido de avaliação morre por falta de p: Review requests die from lack of process, not lack of will. Three cheap habits that keep them going:
t.resolve, alguém manda. Se for preciso ca: does the job, someone will send it. If you have to hunt for the link every time, nobody will.
t.E ajuste a expectativa: taxa de resposta: And adjust your expectations: the response rate for WhatsApp requests tends to be modest, and it varies a lot with the type of business, the relationship with the customer and how memorable the experience was. Nobody can promise you a number — whoever does is guessing. What can be said is that asking in an organized way yields more than not asking, and that a steady few reviews a week are worth more than a flood in a single month, because Google and consumers give weight to recency.
t.Gere o link direto de avaliação e salve: Create the direct review link and save it as a quick reply. Send it when the result of your service is already visible to the customer. Use the person's name, mention what was done, leave the link on its own at the end. Never ask for a specific rating, never offer a reward, never filter who gets the link based on their opinion — and never buy reviews. One reminder at most. And remember that WhatsApp is a booster: what truly sustains volume is capturing the review on site, while the customer is still with you and satisfied.

h.Pelo seu painel StarTouch. Se você já te: Through your StarTouch dashboard. If your business is already registered, the review link and the QR Code are there ready — just copy and paste into WhatsApp.
h.Teste antes de sair mandando. Abra o lin: Test before you start sending. Open the link on your phone, preferably with an account that isn't the business's. It must land directly on the write-a-review window for your profile — not on search, not on another location's listing. A wrong link sent to 200 customers is a week of work thrown away.
h.A mesma mensagem, mandada em dois moment: The same message, sent at two different moments, gets very different results. The rule of thumb: send it while the experience is still fresh and the result is already visible to the customer.
h.Salão, barbearia, estética: no mesmo dia: Salon, barbershop, beauty clinic: the same day, a few hours later — the person has already looked in the mirror ten times and gotten a compliment from someone.
h.Oficina mecânica: 1 a 2 dias depois da r: Auto repair shop: 1 to 2 days after pickup, when the customer has driven the car and seen the problem is gone.
h.Restaurante com delivery: 1 a 2 horas de: Restaurant with delivery: 1 to 2 hours after delivery. After that, dinner is a memory and the chances plummet.
h.Loja / varejo: no mesmo dia ou no dia se: Store / retail: the same day or the day after the purchase; if it's a product that needs to be used (appliance, furniture), 3 to 5 days.
h.Serviço técnico (ar-condicionado, inform: Technical service (air conditioning, IT, pest control): the day after the service — time to confirm it solved the problem.
h.Clínica / consultório: depois da consult: Clinic / practice: after the appointment or follow-up, taking extra care not to mention any diagnosis, procedure or health information in the message.
h.Nome da pessoa. \"Oi, Marcela\" e \"Olá,: The person's name. "Hi, Marcela" and "Hello, customer" get response rates from different universes.
h.Referência ao que aconteceu. \"a revisão: A reference to what happened. "the service on the Gol", "yesterday's haircut", "the lunch order". It shows it's a message from a person, not an automated blast.
h.Pedido claro com o esforço explícito. \": A clear request that states the effort. "it takes just a minute", "just tap the stars". It reduces resistance from people who imagine a long form.
h.O link, sozinho, no fim. Link no meio de: The link, on its own, at the end. A link in the middle of a paragraph goes unnoticed. Put it on the last line, by itself.
h.E o que não pode estar na mensagem:: And what can't be in the message:
h.Nada de \"5 estrelas\". Pedir nota espec: No "5 stars". Asking for a specific rating violates Google's policies and turns a legitimate request into an improper incentive. Ask for their opinion, not the rating.
h.Nada de desconto, brinde, sorteio ou cas: No discounts, freebies, raffles or cashback in exchange. Rewards for reviews are prohibited and traceable — the pattern shows.
h.Nada de perguntar antes se gostou pra só: No asking first whether they liked it and only then sending the link. That's review gating: filtering who reaches Google based on the person's opinion. Google prohibits it, and the risk is mass removal of the reviews you already have. Send the same link to everyone.
h.E, obviamente, nada de comprar avaliação: And, obviously, no buying reviews. It's fraud, Google detects it in bulk and the drop comes all at once. No shortcut is worth losing your profile.
h.Nada de cobrança. Um pedido. Se não resp: No pressuring. One request. If they don't reply, at most one gentle reminder a few days later. Insisting burns the customer.
h.Sobre disparo em massa: mandar a mesma m: About mass sending: sending the same message to hundreds of numbers at once is the fastest way to get your number blocked by WhatsApp — and identical repeated text also draws attention on Google's side. Prefer sending individually or in small batches, with the person's name and the service reference genuinely changed.
h.Depende de alguém lembrar. Na segunda-fe: It depends on someone remembering. On a busy Monday, with a line at the counter, nobody stops to message the day's 14 customers. The routine falls apart within two weeks — that's the pattern.
h.Chega frio. Quando a mensagem toca, o cl: It arrives cold. When the message pings, the customer is on the bus, at work, in the middle of something else. The peak of satisfaction has passed. Asking while the person is still at your counter, satisfied, always converts better than asking hours later.
h.Some na conversa. O link entra num fluxo: It gets lost in the chat. The link lands in a stream of dozens of other unread conversations. Lots of people intend to review and simply forget.
h.Isso não quer dizer que não valha a pena: That doesn't mean it's not worth it — it is, and it's free. It means WhatsApp works better as a booster than as the main method. The main method is capturing the review on site, in the minute the customer is satisfied and has the phone in hand: a stand on the counter that they tap or scan and land straight on the review screen. Zero dependence on someone remembering to send a message later.
h.A combinação que costuma funcionar melho: The combination that usually works best for local businesses is simple: a stand on the counter for those who are there + WhatsApp for those who have already left (delivery, off-site service, past customers). Each covers what the other misses.
h.Um horário fixo. Ex.: todo dia às 18h, o: A fixed time. E.g.: every day at 6 p.m., the person in charge messages the customers served that day. 10 minutes, always at the same time.
h.Um número simples de acompanhar. Quantas: One simple number to track. How many new reviews came in this month. You don't need a pretty spreadsheet — you need someone watching.
